CREATE TABLE source_reviews (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reviewer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	document_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	manufacturer VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	revision VARCHAR(180) NOT NULL, 
	applicability TEXT NOT NULL, 
	page_start INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	page_end INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_source_review_sequence UNIQUE (company_id, document_id, sequence), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER source_reviews_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON source_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION feniq_snapshot_immutable()
